title: Critic Memo
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. Output of scientific-critic. Cross-examines the panel_reviews for internal contradictions, unresolved tensions, and gaps not covered by either reviewer. Flags items that must be resolved before synthesis can APPROVE.

cross_findings.description: items where the two reviewers contradict each other or one reviewer's finding undermines the other's PASS judgment

description.description: human-readable description of the tension or contradiction

resolution_path.description: suggested path to resolve this tension (may be empty if critic cannot suggest one)

block_flags.description: explicit block signals that synthesis cannot APPROVE without documented rebuttal; derived from severity-BLOCK findings + unresolved contradictions

flag_text.description: one-line statement of the blocking issue

source.description: where this block flag originates: reviewer finding id, cross-finding, or critic's own assessment

defensible_path.description: minimal change that would make this flag defensible; empty if critic sees no path

gaps.description: topics not covered by either reviewer that the critic considers important

critic_notes.description: free-form additional commentary from the scientific critic
